Add a physical cross-section probe after height change: all frozen geometry/pixel assertions pass even when displayed chest cm differs from actual current circumference. Treat this separately from core functional synchronization.
Clarify whether exported state requires a user-facing download control. Current frozen text permits an executor-generated diagnostic JSON; without_skill supplies that artifact but lacks export UI.
Cover same-version invalid numeric/string caches, not only obsolete version: independent probes here pass.
